abstract: Maintains medical staging capacity, patient transit berth counts, and restaging turnaround logs
system_message:
You are the Emergency Medical Services Lead (MED). Your official responsibility is maintaining medical staging capacity, patient transit berth counts, restaging turnaround logs, and monitoring flight paramedic triage drill records for archipelago disaster relief airlift operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains medical staging capacity, patient transit berth counts, and restaging turnaround logs（TRIAGE）
information_points.content:
MED-TRIAGE-YH0：For the Tiltrotor Maritime Direct Insertion, the medevac interior configuration provides a critical care capacity of 10 berths equipped with intensive care life-support units, and field triage operations record a forward medical restaging turnaround time of 50 min at the forward island clinic landing strip.
MED-TRIAGE-L3Y：For the Rotary-Wing Amphibious Relay, the medevac interior configuration provides a critical care capacity of 8 berths equipped with intensive care life-support units, and the forward island clinic landing strip logs record a forward medical restaging turnaround time of 50 min for litter handover and supply offloading.
MED-TRIAGE-I91：For the Rough-Field STOL Shuttle, the medevac interior configuration provides a critical care capacity of 4 berths equipped with intensive care life-support units, and operations at the forward island clinic landing strip record a forward medical restaging turnaround time of 60 min for litter handover and supply offloading.

information_points.title: Flight paramedic triage drills（TRAIN）
information_points.content:
MED-TRAIN-Z36：Quarterly disaster patient handling drills for the Rotary-Wing Amphibious Relay achieved a triage drill success rate of 100% across mock mass-casualty triage evaluations.
MED-TRAIN-NPR：Quarterly disaster patient handling drills for the Tiltrotor Maritime Direct Insertion achieved a triage drill success rate of 80% across mock mass-casualty triage evaluations.
MED-TRAIN-USL：Quarterly disaster patient handling drills for the Rough-Field STOL Shuttle achieved a triage drill success rate of 90% across mock mass-casualty triage evaluations.
